name: CreatePipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The pipeline will be created under this AgentSpace
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，流水线将创建在该 AgentSpace 下
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.example: 从 SLS 采集 Trace 数据清洗入 Dataset
parameters.help_en: The description of the pipeline. Maximum length: 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 流水线描述，最长 256 个字符
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The bootstrap start time in UNIX seconds. It has the same precision as runOnce or scheduled fromTime. Millisecond values greater than or equal to 1e12 are automatically converted. The cursor starts from this time aligned to the grid and catches up window by window. After catching up, it switches to minute intervals. By default, it starts from the current time and processes only incremental data
fields.help_zh: bootstrap 历史起点，Unix 秒时间戳（与 runOnce/scheduled.fromTime 同精度；≥1e12 的毫秒值自动兼容折算）：游标从该时刻网格对齐起步逐窗追平，追平后转分钟间隔；缺省从当前时刻起步只看增量
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The continuous execution configuration. This is used when the type is trace. The processing frequency is a fixed value managed by the server
fields.help_zh: 持续执行配置（type 为 trace 时使用；处理频率为服务端管理的固定值）
fields.name: continuous

fields.help_en: The scheduling mode. Valid values: RunOnce (single execution) and Scheduled (periodic scheduling)
fields.help_zh: 调度模式：RunOnce（单次执行）或 Scheduled（周期调度）
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The start time of the data processing window in UNIX seconds. The value must be less than the toTime value
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口起始时间，Unix 秒，必须小于 toTime
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the data processing window in UNIX seconds. The value must be greater than the fromTime value
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口结束时间，Unix 秒，必须大于 fromTime
fields.name: to_time

fields.help_en: The single execution configuration. This parameter is required only when the mode is RunOnce
fields.help_zh: 单次执行配置，仅 mode 为 RunOnce 时必填
fields.name: run_once

fields.help_en: The start time of the scheduling in UNIX milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 调度起始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The scheduling interval. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d
fields.help_zh: 调度间隔，支持 1h / 6h / 12h / 1d
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The periodic scheduling configuration. This parameter is required only when the mode is Scheduled
fields.help_zh: 周期调度配置，仅 mode 为 Scheduled 时必填
fields.name: scheduled

fields.help_en: The ID of the node
fields.help_zh: 节点 Id
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The parameters of the node. This is a key-value structure and varies based on the node type
fields.help_zh: 节点参数，键值结构，随节点类型而定
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The type of the node
fields.help_zh: 节点类型
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of nodes
fields.help_zh: 节点列表
fields.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The pipeline configuration, including node orchestration
parameters.name: pipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline. The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 流水线名称，3~63 个字符，仅允许小写字母、数字和连字符
parameters.name: pipeline_name

fields.help_en: The name of the agent space to which the default destination dataset belongs

fields.help_en: The default write destination used when no conditional route is matched
fields.help_zh: 未命中任何条件路由时使用的默认写入目标
fields.name: default_sink

fields.help_en: The route matching mode. Currently, only all is supported
fields.help_zh: 路由匹配模式，当前仅支持 all
fields.name: match_mode

fields.help_en: The route expression in Search Processing Language (SPL). Only where, project, and extend are supported
fields.help_zh: 路由表达式（SPL），仅支持 where、project、extend
fields.name: expression

fields.help_en: The route ID
fields.help_zh: 路由 Id

fields.help_zh: 目标 Dataset 所属 AgentSpace 名称

fields.help_en: The write destination for the route

fields.help_en: The list of conditional routes
fields.help_zh: 条件路由列表

fields.help_en: The conditional routing configuration. This is used only when sink.type is set to condition
fields.help_zh: 条件分流配置，仅 sink.type 为 condition 时使用

fields.help_en: The name of the agent space to which the destination dataset belongs
fields.help_zh: 目标数据集所属 AgentSpace 名称

fields.help_en: The name of the destination dataset
fields.help_zh: 目标数据集名称
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The destination dataset configuration for the dataset sink. This is used only when sink.type is set to dataset
fields.help_zh: 目标数据集配置
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The destination type. Currently, dataset is supported
fields.help_zh: 目标类型，当前支持 Dataset
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The pipeline sink, which is the data write destination
parameters.help_zh: Pipeline 目标（数据写入目标）
parameters.name: sink

fields.help_en: The name of the source dataset
fields.help_zh: 源 Dataset 名称
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The data filter condition for the dataset
fields.help_zh: Dataset 数据过滤条件
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en: The dataset datasource config under the current agent space
fields.help_zh: 当前 AgentSpace 下的 Dataset 数据源配置
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The name of the field
fields.help_zh: 字段名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The data type of the field. Valid values: text, long, double, and json
fields.help_zh: 字段类型，支持 text、long、double、json
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The input fields and their data types. This applies to all data source types
fields.help_zh: 输入字段及字段类型，适用于所有数据源类型
fields.name: input_fields

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore
fields.help_zh: SLS Logstore 名称
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project
fields.help_zh: SLS Project 名称
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The data filtered query statement, which uses the Simple Log Service query and analysis syntax
fields.help_zh: 数据筛选查询语句（SLS 查询/分析语法）
fields.name: query

fields.help_en: The Simple Log Service Logstore datasource config
fields.help_zh: SLS Logstore 数据源配置
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The list of enrichment columns. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility. The current implementation outputs only the fixed agent_trajectory column, and this parameter no longer affects the output
fields.help_zh: 富化列清单（兼容保留）：当前实现固定输出单列 agent_trajectory，本参数不再影响输出
fields.name: columns

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable trajectory enrichment
fields.help_zh: 是否开启轨迹富化
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The trajectory enrichment configuration. It mounts trajectory data into the scrubbing results based on the trace_id. When writing to a dataset, the data is stored in the fixed agent_trajectory column, where the column value is the trajectory JSON content
fields.help_zh: 轨迹富化：按 trace_id 将轨迹数据挂载进清洗结果；写入数据集时以固定列 agent_trajectory 承载（列值为轨迹 JSON 内容）
fields.name: enrich

fields.help_en: The trajectory data configuration. This is optional and takes effect only when the type is set to trace. It retrieves ATIF standard trajectory data from the trajectory scrubbing service and extends it based on features
fields.help_zh: 轨迹数据配置（可选，type 为 trace 时生效）：从轨迹清洗服务获取 ATIF 标准轨迹数据，按功能扩展
fields.name: trajectory

fields.help_en: The data source type. Currently, Simple Log Service is supported
fields.help_zh: 数据源类型，当前支持 SLS
fields.name: type
